title: Interoperability does have a legacy cost but if we put effort into our metadata and standards tools can be built like the oer commons resource builder
summary: Interoperability does have a legacy cost but if we put effort into our metadata and standards tools can be built like the oer commons resource builder and Google Docs importer to make easier on everyday people. We can get there I am commenting on the #oer18 feed from my own website using #indieweb tools. I get to own my data and decide where to share it.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Interoperability does have a legacy cost but if we put effort into our metadata and standards tools can be built like the oer commons resource builder and Google Docs importer to make easier on everyday people.

We can get there I am commenting on the #oer18 feed from my own website using #indieweb tools.

I get to own my data and decide where to share it.
